name: app-oviah-splash-and-home-screen-side-by-side-mockups
title: OVIAH splash screen and home dashboard shown side by side as tilted phone mockups on a gold-thread backdrop
whatItIs: Two tilted phone mockups: a white splash screen with the OVIAH droplet logo and 'Get Started' buttons on a plain background, and the home dashboard (greeting, week strip, ovulation countdown ring, 'Expecting Period on 20 August') resting on a backdrop of looping gold threads.
whatItMeans: Polished and contrasting; pairing a plain splash mockup with an elaborately styled dashboard mockup shows range in presentation.
techniques: Vary mockup backdrop elaborateness to suit each screen's role.
Tilt devices slightly for a more dynamic composition.
Use decorative thread or ribbon textures for a premium feel.

vocabulary.definition: A decorative looping-line texture behind a mockup.
The first branded screen shown when an app opens.
